Powerful 7.7 Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Panama, Damaging Buildings

A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Panama, causing damage to buildings and triggering a tsunami warning for the eastern Pacific, which was later lifted. The earthquake was felt in Panama and neighboring Costa Rica. Videos of destruction circulated online, and TV presenters were seen running for safety during a live broadcast. The earthquake also generated a series of aftershocks.
